title: Shell Chrome Parent Border Hover Emphasis
description: When the pointer is anywhere inside shell chrome (panel, navbar, window), emphasize that container's border. Navbar/footer already work. Fix panel selector mismatch ([data-panel] vs data-slot=panel). Add mode-dock-stack hover border emphasis; active stacks keep border-active-base.
summary: Shell chrome parent-border hover emphasis: retargeted panel hover CSS from `[data-panel]` to `[data-slot="panel"]` so floating panels emphasize their chrome frame on pointer enter; added inactive mode-dock-stack `:hover` rules that emphasize the U-frame (tab cap, gap, controls cap, body) via `--border-emphasized-color` while active stacks keep `border-active-base`; updated class docstrings and extended vitest to assert CSS selectors and `data-slot="panel"` on panel roots.
